description: Rework the To Live (round1) engine model: per-game random 5v5 splits that are cosmetic, advancement by TOTAL goals (top 8 of 10, bottom 2 cut) using the existing boundary-bubble flow, per-game readiness requiring all 10 scores, and migration/validation for the new state. Teams are no longer fixed for the round. This is the highest-risk feature and must land first because the backend endpoint, frontend, and tests all depend on the new model.
steps: In engine.py blank_round(games=5): for the round1 (games==5) branch, REMOVE the per-player fixed 'team':'' field from each player dict (players are now {'goals':[None]*5} like round2's players which carry only goals). REMOVE the round1-only 'assigned':[] key. ADD a new round1-only 'lineups' key: an empty list [] (populated lazily; a populated value is a list of exactly 5 entries, each {'A':[5 player ids], 'B':[5 player ids]} partitioning all 10 IDS). Keep 'extras':[] and 'roster':[].

Add a helper engine.round1_lineups(s) that returns the 5 per-game A/B splits, generating and STORING them on s['round1']['lineups'] if absent/empty, then returning them. Generate each game's split with secrets.SystemRandom().shuffle on a fresh copy of IDS (mirror round2_draw_action's shuffle usage): shuffle, first 5 -> A, last 5 -> B. Generate all 5 games. The function must be idempotent: once lineups exist with 5 valid entries, return them unchanged (never reroll). This is the stability-across-reloads + included-in-backups guarantee.

Add engine.round1_lineup_action(s, action, game=None) for an optional per-game RE-ROLL, guarded like round2: action=='reroll' rerolls ONLY the given game's split (0-based or 1-based consistent with how the frontend calls it; document which) using secrets.SystemRandom().shuffle, but RAISES ValueError (or no-ops) if any player already has a non-null goal for that game, so a reroll never silently invalidates entered scores. Follow the round2_draw_action guard philosophy (saved/scored draws are never rerolled). Unknown action raises ValueError. Return deepcopy.

Rewrite round1_view(s, names_ok): roster=IDS, cut=8 (top 8 advance of 10). Build rows for all 10 players exactly like today (id, name, goals=sum, played=count, average=Fraction(total,played), rank, status) but WITHOUT a 'team' field key (or keep a cosmetic per-game grouping only in the view, not a fixed per-player team). Obtain lineups via round1_lineups-style read (do NOT mutate s inside a pure view function; instead read s['round1']['lineups'] and treat empty as 'not yet generated' -> games not ready / provisional). Remove the two 'Team A/B: assign 5 players' validation issues entirely.

Per-game readiness in round1_view: for each of 5 games, ready = all 10 players (IDS) have goals[g] is not None (0 allowed; no sit-outs this stage). Build games[] as [{'game':g+1,'counts':{...optional...},'ready':bool}]. The 'Complete all five games' issue should now read for the new model (all 10 players need a score each game, 0 for no goals).

Advancement in round1_view: rank ALL 10 players together by average (Fraction) with cut=8 using the SAME rank_bubble + resolve_average_bubble + order_groups machinery round2_view uses for its 6th/7th cut (reg_total/reg_played/rowmap/resolve_avg closure with cut=8). The 8th/9th boundary tie must trigger TIE and the extras boundary-bubble fold, exactly like round2's 6th/7th. When not ready, fall back to order_groups PENDING ranking across all 10. survivors = the 8 ADVANCE ids when ready and not tied. Keep Decimal/Fraction exact.

Update engine.migrate() and engine.validate() for the new round1 shape. In validate(): REMOVE the round1 'assigned' handling block (s['round1'].setdefault('assigned',[]) and the assigned-list validation and the 'Wheel-assigned players must have a team' loop). Add s['round1'].setdefault('lineups',[]) and validate lineups: must be a list; if non-empty it must have exactly 5 entries, each a dict with keys {'A','B'} whose values are 5-element id lists that together partition IDS with no repeats. In the per-player goals loop, REMOVE the round1 team validation (d['team'] in ['','A','B']); round1 players no longer have a 'team' key. Keep goals length==5 and numeric(v,True,True).

Migration/back-compat: old v4 saves may have round1 players with a 'team' field and round1['assigned']. In migrate() (or a normalization step inside validate run before the strict checks), for round1: drop any per-player 'team' key (preserve 'goals'), drop 'assigned' if present, and default 'lineups' to [] (lineups are regenerated lazily on demand). Old legacy (v1/v2/v3) migration paths must still succeed. has_inputs() currently checks d.get('team'); update it so round1 players without a team key still work (d.get('team') already returns None safely, but verify extras/goals detection still correct).

Decide and implement whether evaluate()/bind_rosters flow should auto-generate lineups. Recommended: do NOT generate inside the pure evaluate() path (keep it side-effect free). Instead expose round1_lineups(s) for the server to call when serving/saving so lineups get persisted. Ensure round1_view can render provisional rows when lineups are empty (games not ready) without crashing.

Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 to see which existing tests now fail (expected: fixture() sets per-player 'team', Round1Assign class, test_incorrect_team_counts, test_full_tournament survivor expectations, HTTP round1_assign). Do NOT fix tests in this feature beyond what is needed to import; FEAT-003 reworks the test suite. But DO confirm engine.py imports cleanly and round1_view runs on a hand-built state.
acceptance_criteria: blank_round(5) returns round1 players as {'goals':[None]*5} with no 'team' key, round1 has 'lineups':[] and no 'assigned'.
round1_lineups(s) generates exactly 5 splits, each a 5/5 partition of all 10 IDS, is idempotent on repeat calls, and stores them on s['round1']['lineups'].
round1_view ranks all 10 players by total-goal average with cut=8 (8 ADVANCE, 2 CUT) and no 5-per-team validation issue is ever emitted.
A constructed 8th/9th tie yields status TIE and resolves via the extras boundary-bubble fold (reusing rank_bubble/resolve_average_bubble), mirroring round2's 6th/7th behaviour.

validate() accepts a new-model save (no team keys, lineups present or empty) and a round-trip through json.dumps/validate preserves it; an old v4 save carrying per-player round1 'team' and 'assigned' still loads (team/assigned dropped, goals preserved, lineups defaulted).
round1_lineup_action reroll refuses to reroll a game that already has any entered score.
verification: python3 -c "from engine import new_state, round1_lineups, round1_view, validate; s=new_state(); L=round1_lineups(s); assert len(L)==5 and all(sorted(e['A']+e['B'])==sorted(__import__('engine').IDS) for e in L); print('lineups ok'); print('view ok' if round1_view(s,True)['rows'] else 'empty')"
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 | tail -20 (to catalogue expected failures for FEAT-003 to fix; engine itself must not throw ImportError)
findings:
engine.py reworked only (no app.py/frontend/test/docs changes; those are FEAT-002/003/004). No commit made (FEAT-004 commits). Branch feat/per-match-ranking, no push.

IMPLEMENTED:
- blank_round(5): round1 players are now {'goals':[None]*5} (no 'team' key); round1 dropped 'assigned' and gained 'lineups':[]. round2/final unchanged.
- Added _round1_split() (secrets.SystemRandom().shuffle of a fresh IDS copy; first5->A, last5->B) and _valid_lineups(lineups) (list of exactly 5 dicts each {'A','B'} 5/5 partition of IDS).
- round1_lineups(s): lazily generates+stores 5 splits on s['round1']['lineups'] if absent/invalid; idempotent (returns unchanged once 5 valid splits exist). Mirrors round2_draw_action shuffle usage.
- round1_lineup_action(s, action, game=None): action=='reroll' is 1-based (game 1..5), RAISES ValueError if any player already has goals[game-1] not None (never invalidates entered scores, round2 guard philosophy); unknown action raises; returns deepcopy. round1_lineups(s) is called first so lineups exist before reroll.
- round1_view(s, names_ok) rewritten: ranks ALL 10 players by goals-per-match average with cut=8 (top8 ADVANCE / bottom2 CUT) reusing rank_bubble + resolve_average_bubble + order_groups exactly like round2_view's 6th/7th (straddle_only=True). 8th/9th boundary tie -> TIE + extras boundary-bubble fold. Pure: reads s['round1']['lineups'] without mutating; empty => provisional (not ready) with an 'issues' entry. Per-game ready = lineups present AND all 10 players have goals[g] not None (0 allowed). games[] entries now carry 'game','teams'(the split),'counts','ready'. Removed the two 'Team A/B: assign 5 players' issues and old 5-per-team readiness. No 'team' key on rows.
- validate(): removed the round1 'assigned' block and the per-player round1 team check; added s['round1'].setdefault('lineups',[]) + lineups validation (list; if non-empty must be 5 valid 5/5 partitions of IDS, else 'Invalid To Live game teams.').
- migrate(): added _normalize_round1(s) that drops per-player round1 'team' (preserving goals), drops round1 'assigned', and defaults 'lineups' to []. Called in both v4 (now deepcopies before returning) and the v3->v4 path; v1/v2 recurse through v3 so they normalize too. Legacy v1/v2/v3 migration still works. Decimal/Fraction exact math untouched.
- has_inputs() unchanged: d.get('team') safely returns None for the new round1 player shape.
- round1_assign_action LEFT IN PLACE (still imported by app.py and tests); FEAT-002 removes the app route, FEAT-003 removes the tests.

VERIFICATION RUN:
- python3 -c 'import engine' -> clean (no ImportError).
- python3 -c 'import engine, app' -> clean; node --check static/app.js -> ok.
- Verification snippet from FEAT-001.json: 'lineups ok' + 'view ok'.
- Hand-built scenario script confirmed all 7 acceptance criteria: blank_round shape, lineups idempotent+partition, cut=8 top8/bottom2 with no team-assign issue, 8th/9th TIE then extras fold resolves (p8 folded goals 55/played 6), new-model + old-v4(team+assigned) validate round-trip, reroll refusal on a scored game + unknown-action raise.

EXPECTED NOW-FAILING TESTS (OLD model; FEAT-003 reworks them). python3 -m unittest discover -s tests => Ran 40, FAILED (failures=7, errors=28), NO ImportError.
  Root causes: fixture() sets per-player round1 'team' and expects old 4-of-5-per-team advancement/survivors; validate() now strips 'team'/'assigned'; the whole Round1Assign class and HTTP.test_round1_assign_endpoint exercise the retired wheel-assign model; several Rules/Draws/HTTP tests chain off fixture() so they error downstream.
  Failures (7): test_cut_tie_and_incomplete_extra, test_final_podium_tie, test_full_tournament, test_roster_change_and_rename, test_rotation_balance_and_team_results, test_round2_eight_game_rotation, test_round2_overall_cut_tie_and_extras.
  Errors (28): all of Round1Assign (test_full_assignment_always_five_five_randomized, test_cap_forces_valid_split_under_extreme_bias, test_assigned_excluded_and_grows_by_one, test_reset_clears_only_wheel_assigned, test_manual_override_coexists_and_validates, test_spin_respects_preexisting_manual_without_exceeding_five, test_backward_compat_missing_assigned_defaults, test_unknown_action_raises[errored via setup chain], test_targeted_player_spin_assigns_that_player, test_targeted_player_spin_is_idempotent_when_already_teamed, test_targeted_player_still_respects_five_cap, test_targeted_spins_reach_five_five); Rules downstream of fixture() (test_backward_compat_load_save_with_extras, test_blank_zero_and_fresh_average, test_final_podium_bubble_fold_and_safe_finalist, test_final_podium_still_tied_asks_again, test_independent_live_points_and_counts, test_legacy_round2_archive_and_current_save_preservation, test_multiplier_setting_and_partial_inputs, test_round2_eighth_match_and_invalid_rest_score, test_tenth_game_and_migration, test_third_fourth_tie_and_nonpodium_tie, test_wheel_large_lists_migration_and_validation); Draws (test_balanced_random_draw_all_matches_and_repeat_clicks, test_draw_guards_and_preserves_existing_version3_scores, test_store_draw_cannot_be_changed_by_regular_save); HTTP (test_round1_assign_endpoint, test_round2_draw_endpoint_and_completion, test_persistence_and_revision_conflict).

NOTE for FEAT-002: round1_view now expects s['round1']['lineups'] to be populated for 'ready'; the server should call engine.round1_lineups(s) when serving/saving so splits persist (evaluate() stays side-effect free and does NOT generate them).
